hero.subtitle: Quality Assurance & Compliance
hero.title: Certifications You Can Verify. Not Just Logos on a Page.
hero.lead: Most suppliers show you logos. We show you the audit trail behind them — digital records, batch-level tracking, and verifiable compliance data. Because a certificate without documentation is just a promise.
hero.description: Every certification we pursue is backed by Farm OS documentation — digital audit trails, batch-level tracking, and verifiable records. When certifiers arrive, our data is already organized. When buyers ask for proof, we show them the system — not just a certificate.

introduction.title: Commitment to Excellence — Backed by Data
introduction.description: Most companies display certification logos. We built a digital infrastructure that makes compliance verifiable. Our Farm OS tracks organic inputs, logs worker wages for Fair Trade audits, and maintains batch-level traceability for ISO 22000 — so certification is not a goal to reach, but a standard we document every day.

quality.title: Data-Backed Quality

trust.title: Verifiable Trust

global.title: Export-Ready Compliance

framework.title: Integrated Compliance — Powered by Farm OS
framework.description: Instead of managing five separate certification processes, our Farm OS integrates compliance data into daily operations. One system. Every standard. Always audit-ready.
